role: Multi-hop semantic inference executor for CoB knowledge graph — traverses IS_A, HAS_PROPERTY, PART_OF, CAUSES, ENABLES, PRODUCES, CONSUMES, USED_FOR, and other edge types via bounded BFS to answer questions like 'do cats breathe air?'.
detail: InferenceQueryExecutor is the Layer 3 procedural template for multi-hop semantic reasoning. It executes inference_query procedures by performing breadth-first search across a configurable set of semantic edge types from subject to target node, with confidence propagation using per-type degradation factors. The executor reads operational depth from rule:inference_depth_config EvolutionRule (starts at 1, progresses to 2, then 3 based on success metrics; depth 4+ locked until E5). Key functions: execute() performs the full query lifecycle including node resolution, DENOTES bridge following, cycle detection, confidence floor pruning, truncation tracking (DEPTH_LIMIT_REACHED with frontier analysis), and SemanticInferenceTrace recording (A.19). _traverse_inference_chain() implements multi-edge BFS with visited set to prevent cycles. compute_inference_chain_confidence() combines edge confidences with per-type degradation (IS_A: 5%, HAS_PROPERTY: 10%, PART_OF: 15%, CAUSES/ENABLES/PREVENTS: 20%, others: 15%). check_inference_gate() enforces developmental gating: requires 20+ successful classifications, 5+ distinct semantic edge types, 3+ cross-domain DENOTES edges before inference unlocks. bootstrap_inference_query_template() idempotently creates proc:inference_query ProceduralTemplate, rule:inference_depth_config and rule:inference_gate_config EvolutionRule nodes. Depth advancement (_check_depth_advancement) checks session-start: 1→2 requires success_rate≥0.85, confirmed≥20, clusters≥3; 2→3 requires success_rate≥0.80, confirmed≥15, clusters≥3.
constants: EDGE_TYPE_DEGRADATION={IS_A:0.05, HAS_PROPERTY:0.10, PART_OF:0.15, LOCATED_IN:0.10, USED_FOR:0.10, CAUSES:0.20, ENABLES:0.20, PREVENTS:0.20, REQUIRES:0.15, PRODUCES:0.15, CONSUMES:0.15}
INFERENCE_TRAVERSABLE_EDGE_TYPES=frozenset(IS_A, HAS_PROPERTY, PART_OF, LOCATED_IN, USED_FOR, CAUSES, ENABLES, PREVENTS, REQUIRES, PRODUCES, CONSUMES)
gotchas: None explicitly flagged. Confidence degradation formula multiplies edge confidences by per-type factors — chains degrade faster than IS_A classification (5% vs cross-type). Cycle detection maintained via visited set prevents infinite loops. Truncation metadata (path_found_but_truncated, truncation_depth, continuation_available_at_depth) distinguishes DEPTH_LIMIT_REACHED from NO_EVIDENCE. Metric queries (_compute_inference_success_rate, _count_confirmed_inferences, _count_inference_concept_clusters) read SemanticInferenceTrace nodes for advancement checks. DENOTES resolution used only when subject/target lacks semantic edges (separation of concerns). Depth advancement is session-start only (not per-query). Neo4j queries filter by valid_to IS NULL to exclude expired edges.
